title: Enable automations with existing GCS workspace storage
description: Run after creating a disabled definition in the disposable QA workspace. No storage preparation or runner start.

requires.fixtureModel: Using backend/admin tools in pi-agents-cloud, set a fixture-only modelSelection on the exact disposable QA-owned workspace and definition. Keep the definition schedule far in the future and disable immediately after checking enable. Do not create a bucket, add sharedStorage, change rollout flags, or start a runner.

steps.expected: Selected disposable workspace has its original GCS bucket/prefix and no sharedStorage descriptor.
Enable and Run now are usable after loading. No operator prerequisite or prepare/revalidate button appears. Do not click Run now.
Revisioned PATCH succeeds, Enabled survives Refresh, then Disable succeeds.
Enabled checkbox is usable. Preserve a changed draft Name across Refresh. Check Enabled and save, verify a successful PATCH, then Disable.
No automation-storage/prepare request, bucket creation, runtime/session creation, or automation run occurred. Workspace bucket/prefix and missing sharedStorage are unchanged; definition is disabled.
